main_10_ganesh_temples.title: AA. Dhundhi Vinayak
main_10_ganesh_temples.designation: Supreme Sovereign Gatekeeper of Kashi & Entry Sanctum to Vishweshwar
sanskrit_verses: सर्वार्थानामत्र दात्री भवानी सर्वान् कामान् पूरयेदत्र ढुण्ढि:
paragraphs: class="art-PostContent"> AA. DHUNDHI VINAYAK After Vinayak paved the way for his father, Lord Shiva made a grand entry into Kashi. Lord Shiva praised Vinayak for his deeds. The latter was called Dhundhi Vinayak. All devotees who come to worship Lord Shiva in Visweshwar temple will necessarily have to come across Dhundhi Vinayak as it is the entry point and they will worship him first. A person who worships Dhundhi Vinayak daily in the morning will find all his obstacles removed. A person who merely takes the name of Dhundhi Vinayak with full devotion will be blessed with all kinds of happiness.

Devotees should worship Dhundhi Vinayak on all Tuesdays. More importance is attached to Tuesdays coinciding with Chaturthi (fourth day after Amavasya or Poornima). A person who performs pooja of Dhundhi Vinayak in the month of Magha, Chaturthi after Amavasya will be blessed by God. (Skanda Puran, Kashi Khand, Chapter 57).
Later Shiva went on describing the various forms of Vinayak spread all over Kashi.
Kashi Khand, Chapter 03, Shlok 96
सर्वार्थानामत्र दात्री भवानी सर्वान् कामान् पूरयेदत्र ढुण्ढि:
सर्वान् जन्तून् मोचयेदन्तकाले विश्वेशोऽत्र श्रोत्रमन्त्रोपदेशात्

In this holy Kashi, the goddess who fulfills all the “Arth” (health, wealth, prosperity etc) is Annapurna Devi. Dhundhiraj Ganesha is the one who fulfills all the wishes and Lord Vishwanath frees all the beings from the bondage (Bhav Bandhan) by reciting mantras in their ears in their final stages.
LOCATION OF DHUNDHI VINAYAK
Dhundhi Vinayak is located at the entry point of Annapurna Temple via Gate No.1. Devotees can approach via Dasaswamedh Vishwanath Gully or Bansphatak Vishwanath Gully.
Please watch our YouTube Video about Dhundhi Vinayak at following Link :
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=40af4qZMnqA&t=55s
TYPES OF POOJA

Dhundhi Vinayak is a huge idol of Ganesha at the above point. The place is open practically twenty four hours. Devotees may make offering of flowers or green grass to the Lord and some sweets as Bhog. Since there is heavy patrolling police and other forces, devotees may visit the place early in the morning when there is likelihood of lesser crowd.

main_10_ganesh_temples.title: VAKRA TUND VINAYAK (BADA GANESH)
main_10_ganesh_temples.designation: Grand Sovereign Standalone Ganesha Temple of Kashi (Lohatia)
paragraphs: class="art-PostContent"> VAKRA TUND VINAYAK (BADA GANESH) Vakra Tunda Vinayak is located at K-58/101, Lohatia Bara Ganeshji. He removes ill effects paap karma (sins) committed by devotee and bestows upon them overall happiness. This Vinayak is also known as Bara Ganesh. Devotees can travel upto Lohatia by auto rickshaw or cycle rickshaw and reach this temple on foot.
(VAKRA TUND VINAYAK)
Please watch our YouTube Video about Vakra Tund Vinayak at following Link
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NFXHu2NC_JM&t=56s

TYPES OF POOJA The temple is a stand alone temple and widely worshipped. The temple is open from 04.45 a.m. to 10.30 p.m. Mangala Aarti is held at 04.45 a.m., Bhog at 10.30 a.m. and Shayan Aarti at 10.30 p.m. Wednesday is a special day when special Aarti is held at 11.30 p.m.

main_10_ganesh_temples.title: Shri Sakshi Vinayak Temple
main_10_ganesh_temples.designation: Supreme Divine Witness of Kashi Pilgrimage & Sacred Yatra Recorder

images.caption: Shri Sakshi Vinayak Sanctum • Vishwanath Gali (Varanasi)

sanskrit_verses:
सिंहतुण्डादुदग्भागे कलिप्रियविनायक:
कलहं करयेन्नित्यमन्योन्यं तैर्थिकद्दुहाम् ॥
(Kashi Khand, Chapter 57, Shlok 99 — Located behind Sakshi Vinayak)
main_10_ganesh_temples.location_text: D-10/50, Dasaswamedh Vishwanath Gully (in the immediate vicinity of Manaprakameshwar, Koti Lingeshwar, and Kalipriya Vinayak, just before the turn toward Shukreshwar and Kalika Galli). Accessible on foot via Dasaswamedh or Godowlia.
main_10_ganesh_temples.timings_text: Open daily from 05:00 AM to 11:00 PM. Highly auspicious for darshan immediately following Ganga Snan and Kashi Vishwanath Darshan.
paragraphs: Shri Sakshi Vinayak Temple is one of the most spiritually pivotal Ganesha shrines in the sacred city of Varanasi. In the Sanskrit tradition of Kashi, "Sakshi" signifies the eternal "Witness". Lord Ganesha here stands as the divine notary and scribe of the cosmos who witnesses, confirms, and officially records that a pilgrim has successfully arrived in Kashi, taken bath in the sacred waters of Mother Ganga, and worshipped Lord Vishweshwar.

According to ancient Kashi Yatra tradition, no pilgrimage to Varanasi is considered complete or spiritually validated without performing darshan of Sakshi Vinayak. Devotees visit this sanctum in Vishwanath Gali to show their respects and declare their pilgrimage vows fulfilled.

The sanctum is prominently referenced across multiple chapters of the Kashi Khand and the website's pilgrimage guides as a primary geographic anchor in Vishwanath Gali. Immediately behind Sakshi Vinayak stands Kalipriya Vinayak (D-10/50) and the sacred Manaprakameshwar and Koti Lingeshwar shrines.

Pilgrims traditionally purchase holy red sacred threads, sweets, and coconut offerings here, and offer prayers so that their meritorious deeds in Avimukta Kshetra remain eternally witnessed by Lord Ganesha.

main_10_ganesh_temples.title: Chintamani Vinayak
main_10_ganesh_temples.designation: The Wish-Fulfilling Jewel Ganesha & Reliever of All Anxieties
paragraphs: class="art-PostContent"> CHINTAMANI VINAYAK Chintamani Vinayak is located at K-56/42, East of Ishwar Gangi Talab, Babu Bazar. By worshipping Chintamani Vinayak, the devotees will attain whatever good things they desire. Devotees can travel upto this place by cycle rickshaw, through Laburabir. Ishwar Gangi Talab is a famous place.
(CHINTAMANI VINAYAK)
TYPES OF POOJA The place of worship is open practically throughout and devotees can perform pooja by themselves.

main_10_ganesh_temples.title: Siddhi Vinayak
main_10_ganesh_temples.designation: Bestower of Spiritual Perfections & Success (Manikarnika Ghat Steps)
paragraphs: class="art-PostContent"> SIDDHI VINAYAK

Siddhi Vinayak is located at Ck. 9/1, near Mani Karnika Kund in the steps. Siddhi Vinayak grants Siddhi (attainment) to his devotees. Devotees can travel upto Chowk by rickshaw and walk on foot to this temple. Alternatively, they can take a boat ride upto Mani Karnika Ghat and walk up the steps.
Location of this deity as per Google Maps is given in the following Link

TYPES OF POOJA The place of worship is open practically throughout.

main_10_ganesh_temples.title: Durg Vinayak
main_10_ganesh_temples.designation: Sovereign Standalone Temple of Southern Kashi (Durga Kund)
paragraphs: class="art-PostContent"> DURG VINAYAK Durg Vinayak is located at no. 27/1, behind Durga Kund. Durg Vinayak is a stand alone temple with two entrances and a lot of devotees regularly come for offering prayers. Devotees can travel upto this place by cycle rickshaw or auto rickshaw and famous landmark is Durga Kund which one can never miss.
(DURG VINAYAK)
Please watch our YouTube Video about Durg Vinayak at following Link :
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uzrtWjx_v9Q&t=87s

TYPES OF POOJA The temple is open from 05.00 a.m. to 12.00 Noon and 04.00 p.m. to 10.00 p.m. Mangala Aarti is held at 05.00 a.m., Bhog at 12.00 Noon, Sandhya Aarti at 07.00 p.m. and Shayan Aarti at 10.00 p.m. The aarties are widely attended by many persons. Staunch devotees believe that worshipping Durg Vinayak during or before any job/project, will certainly give success in that venture.

main_10_ganesh_temples.title: Shree Budhivinayak Ganesh Temple (Gyan Vinayak)
main_10_ganesh_temples.designation: Lord of Intellect, Wisdom & Discernment (Khowa Gulli Chowraha)
paragraphs: In Kashi Khand and local Varanasi tradition, Gyan Vinayak is worshipped as Budhivinayak (the Lord of Buddhi — intellect, wisdom, and cognitive clarity). He dispels ignorance, cleanses psychological confusion, and guards Kashi against negative psychic vibrations.
class="art-PostContent"> GYAN VINAYAK
(GYAN VINAYAK)

Gyan Vinayak is located at Khowa Gulli Chowraha at Ck.28/4 Langlishwar temple. Gyan Vinayak guards Kashi against evil forces, according to Kashi Khand. Devotees can travel upto Chowk by rickshaw and walk on foot to this place via Khatri Medical Hall.
TYPES OF POOJA The temple is open from 08.00 a.m. to 10.00 a.m. and from 06.00 p.m. to 08.00 p.m. Aarties are held in the morning and evening.

main_10_ganesh_temples.title: Ganesh Ghat Mandir (Riverfront Ghat Vinayakas)
main_10_ganesh_temples.designation: Presiding Deity of Ganesh Ghat & Sacred Riverfront Protector

images.caption: Mangal Vinayak • Ganesh Ghat / Bala Ghat Sanctum

sanskrit_verses:
Kashi Khand, Chapter 57 & Chapter 61
मंगलो मंगलं दद्यात् सर्वविघ्नविनाशन: ।
तीर्थिकानां च सततं काशीवासफलं दिशेत् ॥
main_10_ganesh_temples.location_text: Ganesh Ghat (adjacent to Bhonsla Ghat, Mehta Hospital, and Bala Ghat / Panchganga), Varanasi. Accessible by boat directly to Ganesh Ghat steps or by walking through the riverfront ghat pathway from Dashashwamedh or Manikarnika.
main_10_ganesh_temples.timings_text: Open daily from 05:00 AM to 01:00 PM and from 03:00 PM to 10:00 PM. Evening Ganga Aarti on the ghats provides sublime spiritual ambiance.
paragraphs: Ganesh Ghat Mandir is the iconic riverfront shrine presiding over Ganesh Ghat on the sacred river Ganga in Varanasi. Historically known as one of the prominent stone ghats of northern Varanasi (situated between Mehta Hospital, Bhonsla Ghat, and Bala Ghat near Agneeshwar and Nageshwar), it provides direct stone staircase access from the river to the sacred sanctum.

According to Kashi Khand and the website's ghat documentation, devotees approaching Agneeshwar, Nageshwar, and Mangala Gauri regularly arrive by boat at Ganesh Ghat / Bhonsla Ghat and climb the sacred steps to offer their first salutations at the Ganesh Ghat Mandir.

Worshipping the riverfront Vinayaka at Ganesh Ghat removes all travel exhaustion, cleanses obstacles accumulated during pilgrimage, and invokes the eternal blessings of Mangal Vinayak and Manikarnika Vinayak who stand vigil over the holy riverfront.
Pilgrims customarily take a sacred holy dip at Ganesh Ghat and offer fresh Ganga water, red hibiscus flowers, and modaks to the Lord before proceeding into the labyrinthine alleys of the city.

main_10_ganesh_temples.title: Shalakanta Vinayak Temple (Shal Kant Vinayak)
main_10_ganesh_temples.designation: Dispeller of Thorns, Obstacles & Mental Anguish (Manduadih)
paragraphs: class="art-PostContent"> SHAL KANT VINAYAK Shal Kant Vinayak is located near a pond in Manduadih which is somewhat in the western border of Varanasi. Worshipping this Vinayak will yield all sorts of happiness
TYPES OF POOJA The place of worship is open practically throughout and devotees can perform pooja by themselves.

main_10_ganesh_temples.title: Kharva Vinayak
main_10_ganesh_temples.designation: Guardian of the Confluence & Rajghat Fort Sanctum (Varuna Sangam)
paragraphs: class="art-PostContent"> KHARVA VINAYAK Kharva Vinayak is located at Rajghat Fort inside a house, almost near the Adi Keshav Temple. Devotees can travel upto this place by autorickshaw or cycle rickshaw. Kharva Vinayak blesses all devotees who worship him with sincerity.
(KHARVA VINAYAK) Location of Kharva Vinayak as per google map :

https://www.google.com/maps/place/Adi+Keshav+Ghat/@25.3288669,83.0243932,15z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m6!3m5!1s0x398e2fc96ca9762f:0xd72c9629869ba96f!8m2!3d25.328868!4d83.0428259!16s%2Fg%2F11b6dy3165?entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI1MDEyOS4xIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D Please watch our YouTube Video about Kharva Vinayak at following Link : https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=40af4qZMnqA&t=55s

TYPES OF POOJA The place of worship is open practically throughout. Aarties are held at 07.30 a.m. and 07.00 p.m. and devotees can perform pooja by themselves. At times when the main gate is closed, devotees can have darshan through the grill gate.
